2609.20427.title: When Do Language-Grounded Explanations Help? A Graph-Bottleneck for Farm Monitoring Interpretable Sheep Facial Pain
2609.20427.paper_summary: Automated pain recognition from facial expression could make continuous welfare assessment practical in sheep, but adoption depends on trust: a stockperson cannot act on a score that arrives without justification. We ground a model in the Sheep Pain Facial Expression Scale (SPFES) by letting each detected facial region attend over text embeddings of the clinical descriptors and then test whether the resulting explanations mean anything. They do not. Ablating an entire descriptor changes the predicted logit by about $10^{-4}$, and the most-attended cue agrees with the predicted pain level in only $32.6\%$ of regions, although the attention maps, the learned gate, and the generated text all proposed otherwise. We therefore remove the appearance bypass with a concept bottleneck whose classifier reads only SPFES concept scores, supervised by per-region state annotations that image-level pipelines discard. This costs $0.05$--$0.10$ in Cohen's $κ$ but yields concepts that are demonstrably learned: minority pain-indicating states are recovered at $3.5$--$8.3\times$ their base rates, and the ear and eye severity orderings emerge without severity supervision. Removing the supervision alone leaves $κ$ unchanged while concept accuracy falls to $0.109$, showing that architectural necessity does not imply semantic validity. We also show that pooled concept accuracy is misleading under clinical imbalance and provide a cross-validated, protocol-matched benchmark of seven methods on this dataset.
2609.20427.paper_summary_zh: 自動化的面部表情疼痛識別可以使羊隻的持續福利評估變得可行，但其採用取決於信任：一名牧場工作人員無法根據沒有理由的分數採取行動。我們基於羊隻疼痛面部表情量表（SPFES）建立了一個模型，讓每個檢測到的面部區域關注臨床描述符的文本嵌入，然後測試所產生的解釋是否有意義。結果並沒有。去除整個描述符會使預測的對數變化約為 $10^{-4}$，而最受關注的提示與預測的疼痛水平在僅 $32.6\%$ 的區域中一致，儘管注意力圖、學習的門控和生成的文本都提出了相反的觀點。因此，我們去除了外觀旁路，使用了一個概念瓶頸，其分類器僅讀取 SPFES 概念分數，並由每個區域的狀態註釋進行監督，這些註釋在圖像級管道中被丟棄。這使得 Cohen 的 $κ$ 降低了 $0.05$--$0.10$，但產生的概念是明顯學習到的：少數疼痛指示狀態的恢復率為其基準率的 $3.5$--$8.3\times$，而耳朵和眼睛的嚴重程度排序在沒有嚴重程度監督的情況下出現。僅去除監督使得 $κ$ 不變，而概念準確率降至 $0.109$，顯示出架構必要性並不意味著語義有效性。我們還顯示，在臨床不平衡的情況下，合併的概念準確率具有誤導性，並提供了在此數據集上七種方法的交叉驗證、協議匹配基準。
